message.content: No, there is no mention of Hailey Johnson announcing the new line of high-protein breads before inviting Li Hua to the special bakery event. The first interaction regarding the new gluten-free bread line occurred on April 2nd, while the invitation for the healthy bread tasting event was sent on June 22nd. Therefore, it seems that the gluten-free bread announcement preceded the invitation for the healthy bread tasting event, but there is no evidence of the high-protein bread line being introduced before the special event.
